judged_text: The isAttendee permission check compares attendee.email === user.email case-sensitively. A booker whose attendee record was stored with different letter-casing than their login email (e.g. typed John@Mail.com into the booking form) is wrongfully FORBIDDEN from adding guests to their own booking.

adjudication.rationale: In the new `addGuestsHandler` the permission check `const isAttendee = !!booking.attendees.find((attendee) => attendee.email === user.email);` compares emails with strict, case-sensitive equality. Since attendee emails are stored from user input (`guestsFullDetails` uses the provided email as-is) and there’s no normalization shown, a user whose attendee record differs only by letter-casing from `user.email` could fail `isAttendee` and be incorrectly rejected with `FORBIDDEN`.
